title: Clinic Booking & Patient Platform
summary: Online appointment booking, reminders and patient records for a multi-doctor clinic.
description: A sample project showing how a clinic can move from phone-based booking to a self-service platform with doctor schedules, automated reminders and a reception dashboard.

title: Retail Inventory & Online Store
summary: Unified inventory, billing and storefront for a multi-branch retailer.
description: A sample project connecting in-store billing with an online storefront so stock, prices and orders stay in sync across branches.
highlights: Single stock ledger across branches and online

title: Real Estate Lead CRM
summary: Project website with lead capture and a CRM for site-visit scheduling.
description: A sample project that turns website and campaign enquiries into tracked leads, with follow-up reminders, site-visit scheduling and source-wise conversion reports.

title: Logistics Tracking Portal
summary: Shipment tracking portal and driver app for a regional transport company.
description: A sample project covering dispatch, driver status updates and a customer-facing tracking page with proof-of-delivery capture.
highlights: Driver app with proof of delivery

title: School Management Suite
summary: Admissions, attendance, fees and parent communication in one system.
description: A sample project replacing separate registers and spreadsheets with one platform for admissions, attendance, fee tracking and parent notifications.

title: AI Support Assistant
summary: A knowledge-grounded assistant that answers client questions and hands over to staff.
description: A sample project showing a website assistant grounded in approved documents, with lead capture and human handover for questions it should not answer.
highlights: Lead capture and handover to staff
